notes:
MAJOR UPDATE

- Added the BondoSpawner with its searchable 8,955-item catalog, categories, thumbnails, multi-selection and configurable global keybind.
- Item Spawn now uses the verified restart workflow: select items, confirm, and BondoMod restarts the selected Steam or Epic Games version automatically.
- Prepared items persist across BondoMod and PC restarts and can be managed from the main app.
- Reworked Titles around the reliable close, apply, then launch workflow and added the Item Spawn handoff after a title is loaded.
- Restricted temporary Rocket League routing to the game startup window and automatically restores hosts, DNS and proxy settings after success, timeout, shutdown or failure.
- Fixed repeated Game Sounds playback by deduplicating variant goal, replay and score-update events.
- Kept sound preview, importing and category folders available directly in Game Sounds.
- Marked the MMR Overlay as under maintenance and prevents activation while its public provider is being reworked.
- Added startup and packaged-renderer checks so broken or blank application builds cannot be published.
- Verified FPS, Ball Speed, RL Timer, background mode, overlays, custom content, Item Swapper, Titles and update recovery in the release test suite.
